plan.selection: eligible if last trial has two strict snapshots; rank completed trials descending; Alchemy wins ties; otherwise no new corpus network

plan.boundary_policy: reset history; censor every segment tail; never bridge gaps
plan.interrupted_policy: seal existing bytes, reserve full budget, start new segment
plan.resume_policy: one new segment per invocation; only timeout/connection may resume

quality.latency_semantics: snapshot publication delays; not transaction inclusion latency
blockers: fixed cohort selection is not a qualified market universe
minutes of correlated snapshots do not establish regime or out-of-period coverage
scenario variants and overlapping horizons are not independent observations
engineering evaluation is not a protected final holdout

support.selection: all planned scenarios mature in one partition; chronological nonoverlap
caveats: nonoverlap counts are not statistically independent effective sample sizes
flat observed prices do not prove absence of intervening trades
report uses future labels only for offline QA; never an online feature/filter
engineering evaluation is not a protected holdout
